assumptions.choice: The class parameter strategy selects "csp" or "cc"; the harness runs each separately.
assumptions.reason: One module-level strategy class is required while the specification defines two strategies.

assumptions.choice: Whole-share size uses available cash, reserving stated commission, at 20% for CSP and 100% for CC.
assumptions.reason: The specification states capital percentages but not share rounding or commission treatment.

assumptions.choice: k is calculated when an entry order is submitted and retained for that trade's premium/target calculations.
assumptions.reason: Exit rules reference k times Entry, consistent with an entry-time pseudo strike/premium.

assumptions.choice: Band and profit targets use High; CSP stop uses Low; close-based rules use Close. If CSP stop and profit both occur in one bar, the stop is prioritized.
assumptions.reason: Intrabar event ordering is unavailable in daily OHLC data.

assumptions.choice: A timeout is submitted when 20 completed bars have elapsed since the entry fill bar.
assumptions.reason: This is the literal bar-count interpretation of forced close 20 bars after entry.

assumptions.choice: All exit conditions submit a market close order when observed, which Backtrader executes on the following bar under standard order timing.
assumptions.reason: The specification requires market closes but does not enable same-bar execution.
